16.t: Working with data: loading a boat
q: Read the depth with a 200 g load.
Depth increases steadily: about 1 cm for every 100 g.
The tray sides are 5 cm high. Predict the load that would sink it.
About 470-500 g: water reaches the 5 cm sides and floods in.
Explain, using upthrust, why the boat sits lower when loaded.
More load means more weight; the boat sinks lower until it displaces enough water for the upthrust to equal the new weight.
